## Who we are

### Lynxsoft

[Lynxsoft](https://lynxsoft.be) is an independent scientific software engineering and IT consultancy based in Belgium, actively maintaining and extending the open-source **campsisverse** ecosystem. Specializing in pharmacometrics software architecture, modeling & simulation (M&S) tools, and reproducible scientific workflows, Lynxsoft offers tailored services including:

- Custom PK/PD simulation and Model-Informed Precision Dosing (MIPD) application development
- Scientific R and Python package architecture, validation, and workflow automation
- Campsis integration, custom feature development, and technical support
- Campsis and R simulation training courses

For technical inquiries, custom software development, or support regarding the Campsis suite, please visit the [Lynxsoft website](https://lynxsoft.be) or get in touch at [nicolas.luyckx@lynxsoft.be](mailto:nicolas.luyckx@lynxsoft.be).

### Calvagone

[Calvagone](https://www.calvagone.com) is a scientific consultancy company based in France that sponsored the initial development of Campsis and applies model-based approaches in support of pharmaceutical research and development. As experts in pharmacometrics, Calvagone offers a broad spectrum of scientific consulting services, including:

- Population PK/PD modelling
- Translational pre-clinical PK/PD modelling
- First-in-human dose predictions (large and small molecules)
- Drug-disease modelling
- Clinical trial simulations
- Clinical pharmacology consulting and regulatory advice
- Non-compartmental analysis
- DDI and pediatric PBPK modelling
- NONMEM and Campsis training courses

For pharmacometric consulting inquiries, please visit the [Calvagone website](https://www.calvagone.com) or contact them directly at [contact@calvagone.com](mailto:contact@calvagone.com).
